== Biography ==
'''Mary Glasgow''' was born about 1841 in the United States. The estimate comes from her age of 11 at next birthday in the 1851 census.<ref name="Census1851">Library and Archives Canada, [https://central.bac-lac.gc.ca/.item/?app=Census1851&op=img&id=e002351566 1851 Census of Canada West, Prescott, page 31, lines 11–18, image e002351566], original schedule (accessed 13 August 2026).</ref>

She appeared in the Prescott household of [[Glasgow-4010|Samuel Glasgow]] and [[Unknown-764031|Mary E. Glasgow]]. The census does not explicitly state kinship, so both parent relationships are marked uncertain.
